name: preview
description: Serve temporary private previews of local websites through the host's Tailscale, as real pages that outlive the agent session.

interface.longDescription: Serve a local website as a real page on your other tailnet devices, keep it running after the chat ends, and stop it when the work merges.
defaultPrompt: Serve this project as a private preview.
Show me every preview running on this Mac.
Stop the previews for work that has merged.
